text: I can walk through one draft-then-verify step and say why every target pass yields between 1 and γ + 1 tokens.
I can state the min(1, p/q) acceptance rule and the residual norm(max(0, p − q)), and prove the output distribution equals the target's.
I can compute tokens per target pass and walltime speedup from α, γ and c, and spot when the answer is a slowdown.
I can explain, using B × (γ + 1) tokens per pass and the roofline ridge, why speculation helps at small batch and can hurt at large batch.
I can compare a separate draft model, Medusa, EAGLE, lookahead and n-gram drafting on serving cost, training and exactness.
I can design a production policy for speculation: per-route acceptance metrics, adaptive γ, batch thresholds and KV-cache rollback.
